name: immune
description: Adaptive immune system: detects known failure patterns (pathogens), deploys countermeasures (antibodies), learns from new failures, forgets weak antibodies.

commands.detect: Check task description against known antibodies. Returns matches with score, effective_strength, and decision (auto_deploy/suggest/none).
commands.learn: Create a new antibody from failure/success outcome. Auto-detects domain from keywords.
commands.deploy: Record that an antibody was deployed. Optionally mark outcome (success/failure) to adjust strength.
commands.feedback: Mark antibody as correct (true) or false positive (false). Adjusts strength accordingly.
commands.forget: Remove a specific antibody by ID, or prune all weak (<0.15 strength) antibodies.
commands.seed: Auto-create antibodies from existing lesson history.
commands.status: Report all antibodies with domain breakdown, strength distribution, deployment stats.
